1	/-
2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
5	-/
6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteGaloisQuotientAffine
7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Flat
8	
9	/-!
10	# Uniqueness of finite Galois quotients
11	
12	The universal `T`-points clause in `IsGaloisQuotient` determines the quotient
13	scheme uniquely over the base.  This file packages that observation as a
14	canonical comparison morphism and isomorphism.  The transitivity theorem is the
15	cocycle engine for gluing affine Galois quotient charts: once two restrictions
16	are known to be quotients of the same acted scheme, their overlap isomorphism
17	and every triple-overlap identity follow from uniqueness.
18	-/
19	
20	open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
21	
22	universe u
23	
24	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
25	
26	/-- The data asserted by `IsGaloisQuotient`, retained in `Type` so its universal
27	property can define comparison morphisms. -/
28	structure GaloisQuotientWitness
29	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
30	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
31	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
32	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) where
33	  e : pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ≅ X
34	  over : e.hom ≫ f = pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
35	  equivariant : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).IsEquivariant rho e.hom
36	  universal : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
37	      (h : pullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X),
38	      h ≫ f = pullback.snd t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) →
39	      (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L t).IsEquivariant rho h →
40	      ∃! v : {v : T ⟶ Y // v ≫ g = t},
41	        pullbackBaseChange K L g t v.1 v.2 ≫ e.hom = h
42	
43	/-- A quotient witness together with the quotient projection induced by its
44	pinned base-change isomorphism. -/
45	structure GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection
46	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
47	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
48	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
49	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
50	    (q : X ⟶ Y) extends GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g where
51	  projection : e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g
52	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) = q
53	
54	namespace GaloisQuotientWitness
55	
56	/-- The comparison morphism defined from two specified quotient witnesses. -/
57	noncomputable def comparison
58	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
59	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
60	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
61	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
62	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
63	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
64	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
65	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂) :
66	    {v : Y₁ ⟶ Y₂ // v ≫ g₂ = g₁} :=
67	  (w₂.universal Y₁ g₁ w₁.e.hom w₁.over w₁.equivariant).choose
68	
69	/-- Base change of a witness-level comparison identifies the two pinned
70	base-change isomorphisms. -/
71	theorem comparison_spec
72	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
73	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
74	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
75	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
76	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
77	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
78	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
79	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂) :
80	    pullbackBaseChange K L g₂ g₁ (comparison w₁ w₂).1
81	        (comparison w₁ w₂).2 ≫ w₂.e.hom = w₁.e.hom :=
82	  (w₂.universal Y₁ g₁ w₁.e.hom w₁.over w₁.equivariant).choose_spec.1
83	
84	/-- A witness-level comparison intertwines the quotient projections determined
85	by the two pinned base-change isomorphisms. -/
86	theorem comparison_projection
87	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
88	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
89	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
90	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
91	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
92	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
93	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
94	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂) :
95	    (w₁.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₁
96	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
97	        (comparison w₁ w₂).1 =
98	      w₂.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₂
99	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
100	  let v := comparison w₁ w₂
101	  let bc := pullbackBaseChange K L g₂ g₁ v.1 v.2
102	  have hinv : w₁.e.inv ≫ bc = w₂.e.inv := by
103	    rw [← cancel_mono w₂.e.hom]
104	    dsimp only [bc, v]
105	    simp only [Category.assoc, comparison_spec]
106	    simp
107	  calc
108	    (w₁.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₁
109	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫ v.1 =
110	        w₁.e.inv ≫
111	          (pullbackBaseChange K L g₂ g₁ v.1 v.2 ≫
112	            pullback.fst g₂
113	              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) := by
114	      rw [pullbackBaseChange_fst]
115	      simp only [Category.assoc]
116	    _ = (w₁.e.inv ≫ bc) ≫ pullback.fst g₂
117	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
118	      rfl
119	    _ = w₂.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₂
120	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by rw [hinv]
121	
122	/-- Comparing witnesses with specified quotient projections intertwines those
123	projections. -/
124	theorem comparison_quotientMap
125	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
126	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
127	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
128	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
129	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
130	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
131	    {q₁ : X ⟶ Y₁} {q₂ : X ⟶ Y₂}
132	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y₁ g₁ q₁)
133	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y₂ g₂ q₂) :
134	    q₁ ≫ (comparison w₁.toGaloisQuotientWitness
135	      w₂.toGaloisQuotientWitness).1 = q₂ := by
136	  calc
137	    q₁ ≫ (comparison w₁.toGaloisQuotientWitness
138	        w₂.toGaloisQuotientWitness).1 =
139	        (w₁.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₁
140	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
141	          (comparison w₁.toGaloisQuotientWitness
142	            w₂.toGaloisQuotientWitness).1 :=
143	      congrArg (fun z => z ≫ (comparison w₁.toGaloisQuotientWitness
144	        w₂.toGaloisQuotientWitness).1) w₁.projection.symm
145	    _ = w₂.e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g₂
146	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) :=
147	      comparison_projection w₁.toGaloisQuotientWitness
148	        w₂.toGaloisQuotientWitness
149	    _ = q₂ := w₂.projection
150	
151	/-- Transport a specified quotient witness along an equivariant isomorphism of
152	the acted source schemes. -/
153	noncomputable def transport
154	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
155	    {X X' : Scheme.{u}}
156	    {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
157	    {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
158	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
159	    (rho' : SemilinearGalAction K L X' f')
160	    (e : X ≅ X') (hef : e.hom ≫ f' = f)
161	    (he : rho.IsEquivariant rho' e.hom)
162	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
163	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho' Y g) :
164	    GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g := by
165	  refine ⟨w.e ≪≫ e.symm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
166	  · rw [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, ← hef, Iso.symm_hom,
167	      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, w.over]
168	  · intro γ
169	    have hinv : e.inv ≫ (rho.act γ).hom = (rho'.act γ).hom ≫ e.inv := by
170	      rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, ← he γ, Category.assoc,
171	        Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
172	    change _ ≫ w.e.hom ≫ e.inv = (w.e.hom ≫ e.inv) ≫ _
173	    rw [← Category.assoc, w.equivariant γ, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hinv]
174	  · intro T t h hover hequiv
175	    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvuniq⟩ := w.universal T t (h ≫ e.hom)
176	      (by rw [Category.assoc, hef, hover])
177	      (by
178	        intro γ
179	        rw [← Category.assoc, hequiv γ, Category.assoc, he γ, Category.assoc])
180	    refine ⟨v, ?_, fun y hy => hvuniq y ?_⟩
181	    · change _ ≫ w.e.hom ≫ e.inv = h
182	      rw [← Category.assoc, hv, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
183	    · change _ ≫ w.e.hom = h ≫ e.hom
184	      have hy' : pullbackBaseChange K L g t y.1 y.2 ≫
185	          w.e.hom ≫ e.inv = h := hy
186	      rw [← Category.assoc] at hy'
187	      rw [← hy', Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
188	
189	/-- Comparing a specified quotient witness with itself gives the identity. -/
190	theorem comparison_self
191	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
192	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
193	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
194	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
195	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g) :
196	    (comparison w w).1 = 𝟙 Y := by
197	  classical
198	  have hbc : pullbackBaseChange K L g g (𝟙 Y) (Category.id_comp g) = 𝟙 _ := by
199	    apply pullback.hom_ext <;> simp
200	  have hid : pullbackBaseChange K L g g (𝟙 Y) (Category.id_comp g) ≫
201	      w.e.hom = w.e.hom := by rw [hbc, Category.id_comp]
202	  have heq := (w.universal Y g w.e.hom w.over w.equivariant).unique
203	    (y₁ := comparison w w) (y₂ := ⟨𝟙 Y, Category.id_comp g⟩)
204	    (comparison_spec w w) hid
205	  exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
206	
207	/-- Comparisons of specified quotient witnesses compose transitively. -/
208	theorem comparison_comp
209	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
210	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
211	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
212	    {Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Scheme.{u}}
213	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
214	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
215	    {g₃ : Y₃ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
216	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
217	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂)
218	    (w₃ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₃ g₃) :
219	    (comparison w₁ w₂).1 ≫ (comparison w₂ w₃).1 =
220	      (comparison w₁ w₃).1 := by
221	  classical
222	  let v₁₂ := comparison w₁ w₂
223	  let v₂₃ := comparison w₂ w₃
224	  have hbase : (v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1) ≫ g₃ = g₁ := by
225	    rw [Category.assoc, v₂₃.2, v₁₂.2]
226	  have hcomp : pullbackBaseChange K L g₃ g₁ (v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1) hbase ≫
227	      w₃.e.hom = w₁.e.hom := by
228	    rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L g₃ g₂ g₁ v₂₃.1 v₂₃.2 v₁₂.1 v₁₂.2,
229	      Category.assoc, comparison_spec w₂ w₃, comparison_spec w₁ w₂]
230	  have heq := (w₃.universal Y₁ g₁ w₁.e.hom w₁.over w₁.equivariant).unique
231	    (y₁ := ⟨v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1, hbase⟩) (y₂ := comparison w₁ w₃)
232	    hcomp (comparison_spec w₁ w₃)
233	  exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
234	
235	/-- The canonical isomorphism determined by two specified quotient witnesses. -/
236	noncomputable def uniqueIso
237	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
238	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
239	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
240	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
241	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
242	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
243	    (w₁ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₁ g₁)
244	    (w₂ : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y₂ g₂) : Y₁ ≅ Y₂ where
245	  hom := (comparison w₁ w₂).1
246	  inv := (comparison w₂ w₁).1
247	  hom_inv_id := by rw [comparison_comp, comparison_self]
248	  inv_hom_id := by rw [comparison_comp, comparison_self]
249	
250	end GaloisQuotientWitness
251	
252	namespace GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection
253	
254	/-- The pinned quotient projection lies over the base field. -/
255	@[reassoc]
256	theorem quotientMap_comp_base
257	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
258	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
259	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
260	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
261	    {q : X ⟶ Y}
262	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y g q) :
263	    q ≫ g = f ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)) := by
264	  rw [← w.projection]
265	  simp only [Category.assoc]
266	  rw [pullback.condition]
267	  rw [← w.over]
268	  simp
269	
270	/-- The inverse of the pinned base-change isomorphism has the source structure
271	map as its second projection. -/
272	@[reassoc]
273	theorem inverse_comp_snd
274	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
275	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
276	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
277	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
278	    {q : X ⟶ Y}
279	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y g q) :
280	    w.e.inv ≫ pullback.snd g
281	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) = f := by
282	  rw [← w.over]
283	  simp
284	
285	/-- The pinned quotient projection is invariant under the Galois action. -/
286	@[reassoc]
287	theorem act_hom_comp_quotientMap
288	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
289	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
290	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
291	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
292	    {q : X ⟶ Y}
293	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y g q)
294	    (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
295	    (rho.act gamma).hom ≫ q = q := by
296	  have hinv : (rho.act gamma).hom ≫ w.e.inv =
297	      w.e.inv ≫
298	        ((pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).act gamma).hom := by
299	    rw [← cancel_mono w.e.hom]
300	    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
301	    calc
302	      (rho.act gamma).hom =
303	          (w.e.inv ≫ w.e.hom) ≫ (rho.act gamma).hom := by simp
304	      _ = w.e.inv ≫ (w.e.hom ≫ (rho.act gamma).hom) :=
305	        Category.assoc _ _ _
306	      _ = w.e.inv ≫
307	          (((pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).act gamma).hom ≫
308	            w.e.hom) :=
309	        congrArg (fun z ↦ w.e.inv ≫ z) (w.equivariant gamma).symm
310	      _ = (w.e.inv ≫
311	          ((pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L g).act gamma).hom) ≫
312	            w.e.hom := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
313	  rw [← w.projection, ← Category.assoc, hinv, Category.assoc]
314	  rw [pullbackSemilinearGalAction_act_hom, pullbackGalMap_fst]
315	
316	/-- The quotient projection specified by a Galois quotient witness is an
317	epimorphism.  It is an isomorphism followed by the flat surjective base change
318	of `Spec L ⟶ Spec K`. -/
319	theorem epi_quotientMap
320	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
321	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
322	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
323	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
324	    {q : X ⟶ Y}
325	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y g q) : Epi q := by
326	  let base : Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) :=
327	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
328	  letI : Surjective base :=
329	    ⟨fun _ => ⟨default, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩
330	  haveI : Epi (pullback.fst g base) :=
331	    Flat.epi_of_flat_of_surjective _
332	  rw [← w.projection]
333	  infer_instance
334	
335	/-- Transport a projection-carrying quotient witness along an equivariant
336	isomorphism of acted source schemes. -/
337	noncomputable def transport
338	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
339	    {X X' : Scheme.{u}}
340	    {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
341	    {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
342	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
343	    (rho' : SemilinearGalAction K L X' f')
344	    (e : X ≅ X') (hef : e.hom ≫ f' = f)
345	    (he : rho.IsEquivariant rho' e.hom)
346	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
347	    {q : X' ⟶ Y}
348	    (w : GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho' Y g q) :
349	    GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection rho Y g (e.hom ≫ q) := by
350	  refine ⟨GaloisQuotientWitness.transport rho rho' e hef he
351	    w.toGaloisQuotientWitness, ?_⟩
352	  dsimp [GaloisQuotientWitness.transport]
353	  simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Category.assoc]
354	  rw [w.projection]
355	
356	end GaloisQuotientWitnessWithProjection
357	
358	/-- Extract the full quotient witness from the proposition-valued predicate.
359	This is the sole use of choice in the comparison construction. -/
360	noncomputable def IsGaloisQuotient.witness
361	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
362	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
363	    {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
364	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
365	    (h : IsGaloisQuotient rho g) : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g :=
366	  Classical.choice (show Nonempty (GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g) from by
367	    obtain ⟨e, hover, hequiv, huniv⟩ := h
368	    exact ⟨⟨e, hover, hequiv, huniv⟩⟩)
369	
370	/-- The unique morphism from one Galois quotient to another, obtained by
371	applying the second quotient's universal property to the first one's
372	base-change isomorphism. -/
373	noncomputable def quotientComparison
374	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
375	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
376	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
377	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
378	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
379	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
380	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂) :
381	    {v : Y₁ ⟶ Y₂ // v ≫ g₂ = g₁} :=
382	  ((h₂.witness).universal Y₁ g₁ (h₁.witness).e.hom
383	    (h₁.witness).over (h₁.witness).equivariant).choose
384	
385	/-- The base change of `quotientComparison` carries the second quotient's
386	chosen descent isomorphism to the first one's. -/
387	theorem quotientComparison_spec
388	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
389	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
390	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
391	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
392	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
393	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
394	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂) :
395	    pullbackBaseChange K L g₂ g₁ (quotientComparison rho h₁ h₂).1
396	        (quotientComparison rho h₁ h₂).2 ≫ (h₂.witness).e.hom =
397	      (h₁.witness).e.hom :=
398	  ((h₂.witness).universal Y₁ g₁ (h₁.witness).e.hom
399	    (h₁.witness).over (h₁.witness).equivariant).choose_spec.1
400	
401	/-- Comparing a quotient with itself gives the identity morphism. -/
402	theorem quotientComparison_self
403	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
404	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
405	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
406	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
407	    (h : IsGaloisQuotient rho g) :
408	    (quotientComparison rho h h).1 = 𝟙 Y := by
409	  classical
410	  have hbc : pullbackBaseChange K L g g (𝟙 Y) (Category.id_comp g) = 𝟙 _ := by
411	    apply pullback.hom_ext <;> simp
412	  have hid : pullbackBaseChange K L g g (𝟙 Y) (Category.id_comp g) ≫
413	      (h.witness).e.hom = (h.witness).e.hom := by rw [hbc, Category.id_comp]
414	  have heq := ((h.witness).universal Y g (h.witness).e.hom (h.witness).over
415	    (h.witness).equivariant).unique
416	      (y₁ := quotientComparison rho h h) (y₂ := ⟨𝟙 Y, Category.id_comp g⟩)
417	      (quotientComparison_spec rho h h) hid
418	  exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
419	
420	/-- Comparison morphisms compose transitively.  This is the triple-overlap
421	cocycle identity used by quotient gluing. -/
422	theorem quotientComparison_comp
423	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
424	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
425	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
426	    {Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Scheme.{u}}
427	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
428	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
429	    {g₃ : Y₃ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
430	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂)
431	    (h₃ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₃) :
432	    (quotientComparison rho h₁ h₂).1 ≫ (quotientComparison rho h₂ h₃).1 =
433	      (quotientComparison rho h₁ h₃).1 := by
434	  classical
435	  let v₁₂ := quotientComparison rho h₁ h₂
436	  let v₂₃ := quotientComparison rho h₂ h₃
437	  have hbase : (v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1) ≫ g₃ = g₁ := by
438	    rw [Category.assoc, v₂₃.2, v₁₂.2]
439	  have hcomp : pullbackBaseChange K L g₃ g₁ (v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1) hbase ≫
440	      (h₃.witness).e.hom = (h₁.witness).e.hom := by
441	    rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L g₃ g₂ g₁ v₂₃.1 v₂₃.2 v₁₂.1 v₁₂.2,
442	      Category.assoc, quotientComparison_spec rho h₂ h₃,
443	      quotientComparison_spec rho h₁ h₂]
444	  have heq := ((h₃.witness).universal Y₁ g₁ (h₁.witness).e.hom (h₁.witness).over
445	    (h₁.witness).equivariant).unique
446	      (y₁ := ⟨v₁₂.1 ≫ v₂₃.1, hbase⟩) (y₂ := quotientComparison rho h₁ h₃)
447	      hcomp (quotientComparison_spec rho h₁ h₃)
448	  exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
449	
450	/-- Any two schemes representing the same finite Galois quotient are
451	canonically isomorphic over `Spec K`. -/
452	noncomputable def quotientUniqueIso
453	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
454	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
455	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
456	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
457	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
458	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
459	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂) : Y₁ ≅ Y₂ where
460	  hom := (quotientComparison rho h₁ h₂).1
461	  inv := (quotientComparison rho h₂ h₁).1
462	  hom_inv_id := by rw [quotientComparison_comp, quotientComparison_self]
463	  inv_hom_id := by rw [quotientComparison_comp, quotientComparison_self]
464	
465	@[reassoc]
466	theorem quotientUniqueIso_hom_base
467	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
468	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
469	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
470	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
471	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
472	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
473	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂) :
474	    (quotientUniqueIso rho h₁ h₂).hom ≫ g₂ = g₁ :=
475	  (quotientComparison rho h₁ h₂).2
476	
477	@[reassoc]
478	theorem quotientUniqueIso_inv_base
479	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
480	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
481	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
482	    {Y₁ Y₂ : Scheme.{u}}
483	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
484	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
485	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂) :
486	    (quotientUniqueIso rho h₁ h₂).inv ≫ g₁ = g₂ :=
487	  (quotientComparison rho h₂ h₁).2
488	
489	/-- The hom maps of the canonical quotient isomorphisms satisfy the gluing
490	cocycle on triple overlaps. -/
491	theorem quotientUniqueIso_hom_trans
492	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
493	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
494	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
495	    {Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Scheme.{u}}
496	    {g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
497	    {g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
498	    {g₃ : Y₃ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
499	    (h₁ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₁) (h₂ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₂)
500	    (h₃ : IsGaloisQuotient rho g₃) :
501	    (quotientUniqueIso rho h₁ h₂).hom ≫ (quotientUniqueIso rho h₂ h₃).hom =
502	      (quotientUniqueIso rho h₁ h₃).hom :=
503	  quotientComparison_comp rho h₁ h₂ h₃
504	
505	@[simp]
506	theorem quotientUniqueIso_self
507	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
508	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
509	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
510	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
511	    (h : IsGaloisQuotient rho g) : quotientUniqueIso rho h h = Iso.refl Y := by
512	  ext
513	  exact quotientComparison_self rho h
514

11	/-!
12	# Overlap charts for a finite Galois quotient
13	
14	This file packages the invariant-ring quotient charts attached to stable affine
15	opens and their quotient-side overlaps.  Every overlap carries the full
16	`IsGaloisQuotient` witness for the restricted action.  The reversed overlap
17	comparison is then canonical by uniqueness.
18	-/
19	
20	open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace

22	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

34	/-- Equality of stable opens induces an equivariant isomorphism between the
35	corresponding restricted actions. -/
36	theorem restrict_isoOfEq_isEquivariant {U V : X.Opens}
37	    (hU : ρ.IsStableOpen U) (hV : ρ.IsStableOpen V) (e : U = V) :
38	    (ρ.restrict hU).IsEquivariant (ρ.restrict hV) (X.isoOfEq e).hom := by
39	  intro γ
40	  rw [restrict_act_hom, restrict_act_hom]
41	  rw [← cancel_mono V.ι]
42	  simp
43	
44	end SemilinearGalAction

46	/-- A stable affine open for a fixed semilinear Galois action. -/
47	structure StableAffineOpen
48	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
49	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
50	    (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) where
51	  U : X.Opens
52	  affine : IsAffineOpen U
53	  stable : ρ.IsStableOpen U
54	
55	namespace StableAffineOpen
56	
57	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
58	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
59	variable (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
60	
61	/-- The intersection of two stable opens is stable. -/
62	theorem inf_stable (i j : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
63	    ρ.IsStableOpen (i.U ⊓ j.U) := by
64	  intro γ
65	  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf, i.stable γ, j.stable γ]
66	
67	/-- The open cover of the acted scheme indexed by all stable affine opens.
68	The existing `HasStableAffineCover` producer supplies joint surjectivity. -/
69	noncomputable def sourceOpenCover [HasStableAffineCover K L ρ] :
70	    Scheme.OpenCover X where
71	  I₀ := StableAffineOpen ρ
72	  X i := i.U.toScheme
73	  f i := i.U.ι
74	  mem₀ := by
75	    rw [Scheme.presieve₀_mem_precoverage_iff]
76	    constructor
77	    · intro x
78	      obtain ⟨U, hUa, hx, hU⟩ :=
79	        HasStableAffineCover.exists_stable_affineOpen (ρ := ρ) x
80	      exact ⟨⟨U, hUa, hU⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
81	    · intro i
82	      infer_instance
83	
84	/-- The affine invariant-ring quotient chart attached to a stable affine open. -/
85	noncomputable def quotientChart (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) : Scheme.{u} := by
86	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction i.stable
87	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U
88	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f i.U
89	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f i.U
90	  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections i.stable
91	  exact Spec (CommRingCat.of
92	    (SemilinearAction.invariantsSubalgebra K L Γ(X, i.U)))
93	
94	/-- The structure map of an invariant-ring quotient chart to `Spec K`. -/
95	noncomputable def quotientChartMap (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
96	    quotientChart ρ i ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K) := by
97	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction i.stable
98	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U
99	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f i.U
100	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f i.U
101	  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections i.stable
102	  exact Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
103	    (algebraMap K (SemilinearAction.invariantsSubalgebra K L Γ(X, i.U))))
104	
105	/-- The quotient-side overlap in chart `i` corresponding to `i.U ⊓ j.U`. -/
106	noncomputable def quotientOverlap (i j : StableAffineOpen ρ) : Scheme.{u} := by
107	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction i.stable
108	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U
109	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f i.U
110	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f i.U
111	  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections i.stable
112	  exact (SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen
113	    ρ i.stable (i.U ⊓ j.U)).toScheme

116	noncomputable def quotientOverlapι (i j : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
117	    quotientOverlap ρ i j ⟶ quotientChart ρ i := by
118	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction i.stable
119	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U
120	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f i.U
121	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f i.U
122	  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections i.stable
123	  exact (SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen
124	    ρ i.stable (i.U ⊓ j.U)).ι

126	instance quotientOverlapι_isOpenImmersion (i j : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
127	    IsOpenImmersion (quotientOverlapι ρ i j) := by

129	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U
130	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f i.U
131	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f i.U
132	  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections i.stable

137	theorem quotientOverlapι_self_isIso [FiniteDimensional K L]
138	    (i : StableAffineOpen ρ) : IsIso (quotientOverlapι ρ i i) := by
139	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction i.stable
140	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U
141	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f i.U
142	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f i.U
143	  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections i.stable

145	      SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ i.stable

153	    (SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ i.stable

218	  simp only [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf, i.stable γ, j.stable γ, k.stable γ]

221	noncomputable def quotientTriple (i j k : StableAffineOpen ρ) : Scheme.{u} := by
222	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction i.stable
223	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U
224	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f i.U
225	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f i.U
226	  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections i.stable
227	  exact (SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ i.stable

231	noncomputable def quotientTripleι (i j k : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
232	    quotientTriple ρ i j k ⟶ quotientChart ρ i := by
233	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction i.stable
234	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U
235	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebraK (K := K) f i.U
236	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sections_isScalarTower (K := K) f i.U
237	  letI := ρ.isSemilinear_sections i.stable
238	  exact (SemilinearGalAction.quotientOpenOfStableSubopen ρ i.stable
239	    ((i.U ⊓ j.U) ⊓ (i.U ⊓ k.U))).ι
240	
241	/-- The triple quotient open has the full quotient universal property. -/
242	theorem isGaloisQuotient_triple [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
243	    (i j k : StableAffineOpen ρ) :
244	    IsGaloisQuotient (ρ.restrict (triple_stable ρ i j k))
245	      (quotientTripleι ρ i j k ≫ quotientChartMap ρ i) := by
246	  letI := ρ.sectionsMulSemiringAction i.stable
247	  letI := SemilinearGalAction.sectionsAlgebra f i.U

221	    divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n R s
222	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom
223	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R)) :=
224	  rfl
225	
226	/-- The inverse widened affine comparison restricts the transported class from the top affine
227	open. -/
228	@[simp]
229	lemma divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_symm_apply_val (x : DivFamZarAff C R n)
230	    (U : (overSpec k R).left.affineOpens) :
231	    ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n R).symm x).1 U
232	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
233	          ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
234	            (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom) x :=
235	  rfl
236	
237	end Affine

239	/-! ## The comparison from the chart-typed vehicle
240	
241	`DivFamZar.toAff` (`…AffCompare.lean`) sends a chart-typed class to a widened one at a single
242	affine test, and `DivFamZar.toAff_mapAlgHom` (`…AffFace.lean`) makes that compatible with
243	restriction on the explicit face.  Together they lift the comparison to the *vehicles*, which is
244	what a consumer holding a section over a general test needs.
245	
246	The direction is old → new and only old → new.  That is not a limitation of the construction: it
247	is the content of R2.  A widened certificate cover is an arbitrary family of affine opens, and by
248	`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 §2 / ADDENDUM 4 §4.3 there is a straddling divisor at every
249	genus `≥ 2` that no fixed pair of `P¹` charts can confine, so no map back can exist. -/
250	
251	section Compare
252	
253	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
254	
255	variable (π) in
256	/-- **The comparison of vehicles**: componentwise `DivFamZar.toAff`, compatible under
257	restriction by `DivFamZar.toAff_mapAlgHom`.
258	
259	This is the statement that makes the widened vehicle usable by a consumer that already holds a
260	chart-typed section: it does not have to be re-derived over the widened cover, it transports. -/
261	def divFamZarToAffVehicle {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
262	    divFamZarAff C n T :=
263	  ⟨fun U => (s.1 U).toAff,
264	    fun U V h => by
265	      beta_reduce
266	      rw [← s.compat U V h, DivFamZar.toAff_mapAlgHom]⟩
267	
268	/-- The value of the vehicle comparison at an affine open is the comparison of the value. -/
269	@[simp]

11	/-!
12	# Presented étale covers of an affine base
13	
14	A (singleton, affine) *étale cover* of `Spec A` is a faithfully flat étale `A`-algebra `B`.
15	For the étale-sheafification (plus) construction of the relative Picard functor, the covers
16	of a fixed base must form a *small* directed index: this file realizes them as **presented**
17	covers — a number of variables `n` together with an ideal of `MvPolynomial (Fin n) A` whose
18	quotient is étale over `A` with `Spec` mapping onto `Spec A`.  The type of presented covers
19	of `A` lives in the same universe as `A`, while still capturing every étale cover up to
20	isomorphism of the carrier (`Algebra.EtaleCover.of` and its accessor `ofEquiv`).
21	
22	Surjectivity of the spectrum map is recorded instead of faithful flatness because it is
23	statable without flatness hypotheses; combined with flatness of étale algebras it *is*
24	faithful flatness (`Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_comap_surjective`), and that instance is
25	provided on the carrier.
26	
27	## Main declarations
28	
29	* `Algebra.EtaleCover A`: presented étale covers of `Spec A`, a `Type u` for `A : Type u`;
30	  `E.Carrier` is the covering algebra, with `Algebra.Etale A E.Carrier` and
31	  `Module.FaithfullyFlat A E.Carrier` instances.
32	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.of B hB`: any étale `A`-algebra `B` (with surjective spectrum map)
33	  underlies a presented cover, with carrier identification `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv`.
34	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.Refines`: `E'` refines `E` when the covering spectrum of `E'` maps
35	  to that of `E` over the base — a mere existence (`Prop`); the plus construction proves
36	  independence of the chosen refinement map, so no choice of map is carried here.
37	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.prod`: the common refinement `Spec (B ⊗[A] B')` of two covers, with
38	  refinement witnesses `prodInl`/`prodInr` — directedness of the index
39	  (`exists_refines_prod`).
40	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.self`: the trivial cover `Spec A` itself, refined by every cover
41	  (`refines_self`) — the base point of the index.
42	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.baseChange`: the pulled-back cover along `A → A'`, with carrier
43	  `A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier` (`baseChangeEquiv`) and the canonical `A`-algebra map
44	  `baseChangeInclude` into it.
45	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`: over a field `K`, every cover
46	  is refined by a finite separable field extension of `K` (single-factor refinement) —
47	  field-extension covers are cofinal, the form the degree theory and Galois descent
48	  consume; `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField` packages such an extension as a cover.
49	-/
50	
51	set_option autoImplicit false
52	
53	universe u
54	
55	open TensorProduct
56	
57	namespace Algebra
58	
59	/-- A presented étale cover of `Spec A`: a finite-variable polynomial presentation of an
60	étale `A`-algebra whose spectrum maps onto `Spec A`.  Presentations keep the type of covers
61	small (`Type u` for `A : Type u`), which is what makes the étale plus construction over
62	these covers a legitimate colimit; the carrier-level content is recovered by
63	`Algebra.EtaleCover.of`/`ofEquiv`. -/
64	structure EtaleCover (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : Type u where
65	  /-- The number of variables of the presentation. -/
66	  n : ℕ
67	  /-- The ideal of relations of the presentation. -/
68	  ideal : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)
69	  /-- The presented algebra is étale over the base. -/
70	  etale : Algebra.Etale A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ ideal)
71	  /-- The spectrum of the presented algebra covers the spectrum of the base. -/
72	  comap_surjective :
73	    Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ ideal)))
74	
75	namespace EtaleCover
76	
77	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
78	
79	/-- The covering algebra presented by an étale cover. -/
80	protected abbrev Carrier (E : EtaleCover A) : Type u :=
81	  MvPolynomial (Fin E.n) A ⧸ E.ideal
82	
83	instance (E : EtaleCover A) : Algebra.Etale A E.Carrier :=
84	  E.etale
85	
86	instance (E : EtaleCover A) : Module.FaithfullyFlat A E.Carrier :=
87	  .of_comap_surjective E.comap_surjective
88	
89	/-! ## Constructors -/
90	
91	section constructors
92	
93	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.Etale A B]
94	
95	/-- Package an explicitly presented étale algebra with surjective spectrum map as a
96	presented étale cover: the ideal of relations is the kernel of the presenting
97	surjection. -/
98	noncomputable def ofSurjective
99	    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B)))
100	    {n : ℕ} (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →ₐ[A] B) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
101	    EtaleCover A where
102	  n := n
103	  ideal := RingHom.ker f
104	  etale := .of_equiv (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hf).symm
105	  comap_surjective := by
106	    haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B := .of_comap_surjective hB
107	    haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ RingHom.ker f) :=
108	      .of_linearEquiv A B (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hf).toLinearEquiv
109	    exact PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat
110	
111	/-- The carrier of `ofSurjective` is the presented algebra. -/
112	noncomputable def ofSurjectiveEquiv
113	    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B)))
114	    {n : ℕ} (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →ₐ[A] B) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
115	    (ofSurjective hB f hf).Carrier ≃ₐ[A] B :=
116	  Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hf
117	
118	/-- Any étale `A`-algebra whose spectrum covers `Spec A` underlies a presented étale
119	cover.  The presentation is chosen (étale algebras are finitely presented, in particular
120	finitely generated); the choice is harmless because consumers only ever use the carrier
121	identification `ofEquiv`. -/
122	noncomputable def of (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.Etale A B]
123	    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B))) : EtaleCover A :=
124	  ofSurjective hB
125	    (Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial''.mp inferInstance).choose_spec.choose
126	    (Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial''.mp inferInstance).choose_spec.choose_spec
127	
128	/-- The carrier of `of B hB` is `B` itself. -/
129	noncomputable def ofEquiv (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.Etale A B]
130	    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B))) :
131	    (of B hB).Carrier ≃ₐ[A] B :=
132	  ofSurjectiveEquiv hB _ _
133	
134	end constructors
135	
136	/-! ## Refinement and directedness -/
137	
138	/-- `E'` refines `E`: the covering spectrum of `E'` maps to that of `E` over `Spec A`,
139	i.e. there is an `A`-algebra map from the carrier of `E` to that of `E'`.  This is a mere
140	existence: the plus construction proves that the induced maps on descent classes do not
141	depend on the chosen refinement map, so no map is carried here. -/
142	def Refines (E' E : EtaleCover A) : Prop :=
143	  Nonempty (E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E'.Carrier)
144	
145	theorem refines_refl (E : EtaleCover A) : E.Refines E :=
146	  ⟨AlgHom.id A E.Carrier⟩
147	
148	theorem Refines.trans {E E' E'' : EtaleCover A} (h : E''.Refines E') (h' : E'.Refines E) :
149	    E''.Refines E := by
150	  obtain ⟨f⟩ := h
151	  obtain ⟨g⟩ := h'
152	  exact ⟨f.comp g⟩
153	
154	/-- The common refinement of two covers: `Spec` of the tensor product of the carriers,
155	i.e. the fiber product of the covering spectra over the base. -/
156	noncomputable def prod (E E' : EtaleCover A) : EtaleCover A :=
157	  haveI : Algebra.Etale A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
158	    Algebra.Etale.comp A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
159	  haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
160	    Module.FaithfullyFlat.trans A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
161	  .of (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat
162	
163	/-- The carrier of the common refinement is the tensor product of the carriers. -/
164	noncomputable def prodEquiv (E E' : EtaleCover A) :
165	    (E.prod E').Carrier ≃ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier :=
166	  haveI : Algebra.Etale A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
167	    Algebra.Etale.comp A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
168	  haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
169	    Module.FaithfullyFlat.trans A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
170	  ofEquiv (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat
171	
172	/-- The first refinement map of the common refinement. -/
173	noncomputable def prodInl (E E' : EtaleCover A) : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] (E.prod E').Carrier :=
174	  ((E.prodEquiv E').symm.toAlgHom).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
175	
176	/-- The second refinement map of the common refinement. -/
177	noncomputable def prodInr (E E' : EtaleCover A) : E'.Carrier →ₐ[A] (E.prod E').Carrier :=
178	  ((E.prodEquiv E').symm.toAlgHom).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
179	
180	/-- Combine refinement maps out of the two factors into one out of the common
181	refinement (the universal property of the fiber product of the covering spectra). -/
182	noncomputable def prodLift {E E' F : EtaleCover A} (f : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
183	    (g : E'.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) : (E.prod E').Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier :=
184	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f g fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _).comp
185	    (E.prodEquiv E').toAlgHom
186	
187	@[simp]
188	theorem prodLift_comp_prodInl {E E' F : EtaleCover A} (f : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
189	    (g : E'.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) : (prodLift f g).comp (E.prodInl E') = f := by
190	  ext x
191	  simp [prodLift, prodInl]
192	
193	@[simp]
194	theorem prodLift_comp_prodInr {E E' F : EtaleCover A} (f : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
195	    (g : E'.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) : (prodLift f g).comp (E.prodInr E') = g := by
196	  ext x
197	  simp [prodLift, prodInr]
198	
199	theorem prod_refines_left (E E' : EtaleCover A) : (E.prod E').Refines E :=
200	  ⟨E.prodInl E'⟩
201	
202	theorem prod_refines_right (E E' : EtaleCover A) : (E.prod E').Refines E' :=
203	  ⟨E.prodInr E'⟩
204	
205	/-- Directedness of the refinement preorder: any two covers have a common refinement. -/
206	theorem exists_refines_prod (E E' : EtaleCover A) :
207	    ∃ E'' : EtaleCover A, E''.Refines E ∧ E''.Refines E' :=
208	  ⟨E.prod E', E.prod_refines_left E', E.prod_refines_right E'⟩
209	
210	/-- The trivial cover of `Spec A` by itself. -/
211	noncomputable def self (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : EtaleCover A :=
212	  .of A (by
213	    rw [show algebraMap A A = RingHom.id A from rfl, PrimeSpectrum.comap_id]
214	    exact fun p => ⟨p, rfl⟩)
215	
216	/-- The carrier of the trivial cover is the base ring. -/
217	noncomputable def selfEquiv (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : (self A).Carrier ≃ₐ[A] A :=
218	  ofEquiv A _
219	
220	/-- The canonical refinement map from the trivial cover to any cover (algebra side: the
221	structure map of the carrier, through the trivial carrier's identification with `A`). -/
222	noncomputable def fromSelf (E : EtaleCover A) : (self A).Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier :=
223	  (Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).comp (selfEquiv A).toAlgHom
224	
225	/-- Every cover refines the trivial cover: the trivial cover is the base point of the
226	refinement preorder. -/
227	theorem refines_self (E : EtaleCover A) : E.Refines (self A) :=
228	  ⟨E.fromSelf⟩
229	
230	/-! ## Base change -/
231	
232	section baseChange
233	
234	variable (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] [Algebra A A']
235	
236	/-- The base change of a cover along `A → A'`: the cover of `Spec A'` with carrier
237	`A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier` (the fiber product of the covering spectrum with the new base). -/
238	noncomputable def baseChange (E : EtaleCover A) : EtaleCover A' :=
239	  .of (A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat
240	
241	/-- The carrier of the base-changed cover is the base-changed carrier. -/
242	noncomputable def baseChangeEquiv (E : EtaleCover A) :
243	    (E.baseChange A').Carrier ≃ₐ[A'] A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
244	  ofEquiv (A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat
245	
246	/-- The canonical map from the carrier of a cover to the carrier of its base change,
247	as a map of `A`-algebras. -/
248	noncomputable def baseChangeInclude (E : EtaleCover A) :
249	    E.Carrier →ₐ[A] (E.baseChange A').Carrier :=
250	  (((E.baseChangeEquiv A').symm.toAlgHom).restrictScalars A).comp
251	    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
252	
253	/-- The base change of a refinement map: `A' ⊗[A] —` on carriers, through the
254	presented-carrier identifications — the functoriality of `baseChange` in the cover. -/
255	noncomputable def baseChangeMap {E F : EtaleCover A} (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) :
256	    (E.baseChange A').Carrier →ₐ[A'] (F.baseChange A').Carrier :=
257	  ((F.baseChangeEquiv A').symm.toAlgHom).comp
258	    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id A' A') h).comp (E.baseChangeEquiv A').toAlgHom)
259	
260	/-- Base change of refinement maps commutes with the canonical inclusions into the base
261	change. -/
262	theorem baseChangeMap_comp_baseChangeInclude {E F : EtaleCover A}
263	    (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) :
264	    ((baseChangeMap A' h).restrictScalars A).comp (E.baseChangeInclude A')
265	      = (F.baseChangeInclude A').comp h := by
266	  ext x
267	  simp [baseChangeMap, baseChangeInclude]
268	
269	end baseChange
270	
271	/-! ## Covers of a field: single-factor refinement -/
272	
273	section field
274	
275	variable {K : Type u} [Field K]
276	
277	/-- The carrier of a cover of a field (indeed, of any nontrivial base) is nontrivial. -/
278	theorem nontrivial_carrier (E : EtaleCover A) [Nontrivial A] : Nontrivial E.Carrier :=
279	  PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.mp
280	    ⟨(E.comap_surjective (Nonempty.some inferInstance)).choose⟩
281	
282	/-- **Field cofinality**: over a field, every presented étale cover is refined by a finite
283	separable field extension.  This single-factor refinement is what makes field-extension
284	covers cofinal among étale covers of `Spec K`: the étale carrier is a finite product of
285	finite separable extensions of `K`, and projection to any one factor still covers the
286	(one-point) spectrum of `K`. -/
287	theorem exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom (E : EtaleCover K) :
288	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
289	      (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L), Nonempty (E.Carrier →ₐ[K] L) := by
290	  haveI : Nontrivial E.Carrier := E.nontrivial_carrier
291	  obtain ⟨I, hI, Ai, hfield, halg, e, h⟩ :=
292	    (Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod K E.Carrier).mp inferInstance
293	  haveI : Nonempty I := by
294	    by_contra hempty
295	    haveI : IsEmpty I := not_nonempty_iff.mp hempty
296	    haveI : Subsingleton E.Carrier := e.toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr inferInstance
297	    exact false_of_nontrivial_of_subsingleton E.Carrier
298	  obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty I›
299	  exact ⟨Ai i, hfield i, halg i, (h i).1, (h i).2,
300	    ⟨(Pi.evalAlgHom K Ai i).comp e.toAlgHom⟩⟩
301	
302	variable (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
303	
304	instance : Algebra.Etale K L where
305	  formallyEtale := Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable K L
306	  finitePresentation :=
307	    (Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType (R := K) (A := L)).mp inferInstance
308	
309	/-- A finite separable field extension as an étale cover of `Spec K` (the spectrum map
310	between the one-point spectra is trivially surjective). -/
311	noncomputable def ofField : EtaleCover K :=
312	  .of L fun _ => ⟨default, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
313	
314	/-- The carrier of the field cover is the field extension itself. -/
315	noncomputable def ofFieldEquiv : (ofField (K := K) L).Carrier ≃ₐ[K] L :=
316	  ofEquiv L _
317	
318	end field
319	
320	end EtaleCover
321	
322	end Algebra

8	/-!
9	# The widened vehicle and divisor functor: carrying a widened class to a GENERAL test
10	
11	`divFamZarAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation` (`…AffAssemble.lean`) is the endpoint of
12	the widened certificate lane, and what it returns is a class **at an affine test**
13	`DivFamZarAff C R n`.  Every DD-R consumer is stated against a *functor* on the whole slice
14	over `Spec k`, so between the lane's endpoint and its consumers sits the affine-opens limit —
15	the `divFamZar` vehicle of `DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean` — and that layer had no widened
16	counterpart.  This file supplies it, following the chart-typed template line for line.
17	
18	## The shape, and why it is unchanged by R2
19	
20	A section over a test `T` is a family of widened classes, one per affine open of `T.left`,
21	compatible under restriction.  R2 widened where the pieces live **on the curve**; it changed
22	nothing about the Zariski structure of the **base**.  So the vehicle's shape is literally the
23	old one with `DivFamZar` replaced by `DivFamZarAff` and `mapAlgHom` by the widened face of
24	`…AffFace.lean` — which is precisely why that face had to exist first.
25	
26	`[IsProper C.hom]` is carried throughout: the widened base change needs it (an arbitrary affine
27	open's overlaps are not affine by fiat), and it is a hypothesis the DD-R lane has everywhere.
28	
29	## What this file does NOT do, stated precisely
30	
31	It defines the widened vehicle and proves its affine collapse.  It does **not** define the
32	restriction `divFamZarAff.map` along an arbitrary morphism of test objects, and therefore does
33	not define the widened *functor* either.  That is the remaining item of the R2 lane
34	(`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 8 §8.3 item 2): its input is the widened form of the base-side
35	Zariski gluing keystone `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`
36	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyZarGlue.lean`), which should port because R2 left the base side alone —
37	but "should port" is a price, not a result, and nothing here assumes it.
38	
39	So a consumer can today be given a widened section over an **affine** test, and the general-test
40	statement is still owed.  Saying which is which is the point of this paragraph: a docstring that
41	advertises declarations a file does not contain is its own failure mode, and this tree has
42	already been bitten by it once.
43	
44	The comparison from the chart-typed side, `divFamZarToAffVehicle` below, does exist, and it goes
45	old → new only — the direction R2 asserts.  The converse is exactly what R2 says fails.
46	
47	## Main declarations
48	
49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAff` — the widened affine-opens limit at an arbitrary test.
50	* `divFamZarAff.eval`, `divFamZarAff.compat`, `divFamZarAff.ext` — the section API.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAffAffineEquiv` — on an affine test the limit collapses to
52	  `DivFamZarAff` of the test algebra.
53	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarToAffVehicle` — the comparison of vehicles, with

9	/-!
10	# The widened carrier's EXPLICIT-MAP face: `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom`
11	
12	`DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` (`…AffMapAlg.lean`) base-changes the widened class along an algebra
13	**tower instance pack** `[Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']`.  That is the right form
14	whenever a tower is already in scope, and it is what the S5b Zariski keystones are stated at.
15	
16	It is **not** the form the divisor vehicle consumes.  `divFamZar`
17	(`DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean`) indexes its compatibility condition by the section-restriction
18	maps `Over.resAlgHom T h`, which are bare `AlgHom`s carrying no tower instance, so the vehicle
19	and hence `divFunctor` are stated entirely at `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom`.  Until the widened carrier
20	has that same face, a widened class exists only at an affine test and nothing carries it to a
21	general one — measured at HEAD: outside the `DivisorFamilyAff*` files the name `DivFamZarAff`
22	appeared nowhere in the tree.
23	
24	So this file is the missing half of the base-change layer, and it is deliberately a *verbatim*
25	transcription of the chart-typed one: same names modulo `Aff`, same statements, same proofs.
26	Nothing here is new mathematics — `mapAlgHom` is `mapAlg` at `RingHom.toAlgebra` of the map,
27	and the two functor laws come from `mapAlg_id` / `mapAlg_comp` at the induced towers.  The
28	value of writing it is that the *consumer* side becomes typeable at all.
29	
30	## Why `[IsProper C.hom]` appears here and not in the chart-typed file
31	
32	`DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` needs it (`…AffMapAlg.lean` §Transport): properness is what makes
33	`AffCoverData.HasAffineOverlaps` free, and the widened certificate transport needs overlap
34	affineness because an arbitrary affine open's overlaps are not affine by fiat the way basic
35	opens of a fixed affine chart were.  It is a hypothesis the DD-R lane carries everywhere, so
36	this costs no generality — but it is stated rather than hidden, since it is exactly one of the
37	things I-0492 clause 4(ii) warns the old typing was silently supplying.
38	
39	## Main declarations
40	
41	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom` — the explicit-map face.
42	* `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_id`, `mapAlgHom_comp` — the functor laws on that face.
43	* `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg_congr`, `mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg` — the face-change bridge, so a statement
44	  proved at a tower can be consumed at a restriction map and conversely.
45	* `DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlgHom` — the Abel hook on that face.
46	* `DivFamZarAff.congr` — transport along an isomorphism of test algebras.
47	-/

90	    mapAlgHom (ψ.comp φ) F = mapAlgHom ψ (mapAlgHom φ F) :=
91	  letI : Algebra A A' := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
92	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A A' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (φ.commutes x).symm

94	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A' A'' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (ψ.commutes x).symm
95	  letI : Algebra A A'' := (ψ.comp φ).toRingHom.toAlgebra
96	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A A'' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => ((ψ.comp φ).commutes x).symm
97	  haveI : IsScalarTower A A' A'' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

103	structure itself: equal algebra structures give equal base changes (the scalar-tower witnesses
104	are proof-irrelevant).  The congruence backing `mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg`.
